remarks: Prime Central Greenwich location! Minutes to downtown shopping, restaurants, library, station and more! In addition, there is a large private balcony. Plenty of closets! Hardwood floors. Laundry facilities in building. Garage space $85/mo based on availability. Don't miss this opportunity! One time purchase assessment of .5 percent of purchase price.
